strings.zh: 柑果球被许多训练家追捧,{NEWLINE}你在旅途中应该能遇到很多{CLEAR}需要柑果球的训练家吧。{SCROLL}遗憾的是虽然关东地区也有柑果,{NEWLINE}但是做柑果球的大师岩铁却在城都。{SCROLL}不过听说,最近尼比市那个去城都{NEWLINE}学做柑果球的青年学成回来了。{CLEAR}或许他可以带动关东的柑果经济呢？
strings.en: Lots of Trainers are crazy about{NEWLINE}Apricorn Balls. I bet you’ll meet plenty{CLEAR}of Trainers on your journey who want{CLEAR}them.{SCROLL}Sadly, Kanto has Apricorns too, but{NEWLINE}Kurt, the master Ball maker, lives in{CLEAR}Johto.{SCROLL}But I hear the young man from Pewter{NEWLINE}City who went to Johto to learn the{CLEAR}craft is back.{SCROLL}Maybe he’ll get Kanto’s Apricorn{NEWLINE}business going?

strings.zh: 有好好考虑过{NEWLINE}再给精灵起昵称吗？{SCROLL}起个好名字的话,{NEWLINE}会让人印象深刻的！{SCROLL}我可是想出过不少优秀的昵称喔,{NEWLINE}比如我的烈雀叫空鬼,{CLEAR}我的小拉达叫大板牙。{CLEAR}我还给别人的妙蛙种子取名叫算头王八,{CLEAR}给别人的杰尼龟取名滋水光头,{CLEAR}给别人的小火龙取名吐火蜥蜴。{CLEAR}哈哈,常磐市是取名鬼才就是我啦。{SCROLL}怎么样,{NEWLINE}要不要我帮你的精灵{CLEAR}取个好听的名字呢？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Have you really thought about your{NEWLINE}Pokémon’s nicknames?{SCROLL}A good name makes a lasting impression!{SCROLL}I’ve come up with plenty of great{NEWLINE}nicknames. My Spearow is Skyfiend...{SCROLL}and my Rattata is Bucktooth.{SCROLL}I named someone’s Bulbasaur Garlic{NEWLINE}Turtle Bastard, someone’s Squirtle{CLEAR}Squirt Baldy...{SCROLL}and someone’s Charmander Firespit{NEWLINE}Lizard.{SCROLL}Ha ha! Viridian City’s naming genius,{NEWLINE}that’s me!{SCROLL}So, how about it? Want me to give your{NEWLINE}Pokémon a nice name?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: Viridian Name Rater. Joke nicknames: 空鬼 Skyfiend, 大板牙 Bucktooth, 算(蒜)头王八 Garlic Turtle, 滋水光头 Squirt Baldy, 吐火蜥蜴 Firespit Lizard. | tone review: 算(蒜)头王八: keeps D-0351 'Garlic Turtle' and adds D-0629 'bastard' so both the turtle pun and the insult survive (D-0627)

strings.zh: 空鬼『Spea——row！
strings.en: Skyfiend: Spea-row!

strings.zh: 大板牙『Ra——tata！
strings.en: Bucktooth: Ra-tata!

strings.zh: 哈哈哈……{NEWLINE}想给哪个精灵取昵称呢？
strings.en: Ha ha ha... Which Pokémon would you like{NEWLINE}to nickname?

strings.zh: 哎呀,{VAR:0101:0}吗？{NEWLINE}是个还凑合的名字吧。{SCROLL}不过呢,{NEWLINE}我现在还可以想一个{CLEAR}更好一些的名字！{SCROLL}怎么样,要让我取名字吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh, {VAR:0101:0}, is it? That’s a so-so{NEWLINE}name.{SCROLL}But I could come up with a much better{NEWLINE}one right now!{SCROLL}What do you say? Shall I name it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 嗨,嗨……不要啊,{NEWLINE}超失望啊。{CLEAR}我取名的鬼才发挥不出来了。
strings.en: Aw, no... That’s such a letdown. My{NEWLINE}naming genius goes to waste.

strings.zh: 唔唔,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0101:0}吗！{SCROLL}这是超有创意的绝好昵称啊！{SCROLL}以后也要好好疼爱{NEWLINE}{VAR:0101:0}哟！
strings.en: Hmm... {VAR:0101:0}, is it!{SCROLL}What a wonderfully creative nickname!{SCROLL}Take good care of {VAR:0101:0} from now{NEWLINE}on!

strings.zh: 喂喂……{NEWLINE}这个不是蛋吗？
strings.en: Hey, hey... That’s just an Egg!

strings.zh: 唔嗯……那么{NEWLINE}起个什么样的昵称好呢。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hmm... Now, what kind of nickname should{NEWLINE}it have?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 这样,可以吗？{NEWLINE}从此这个精灵就叫做{CLEAR}{VAR:0101:0}咯！{SCROLL}比之前的名字更好吧？{NEWLINE}太好了啊~
strings.en: There, how’s that? From now on, this{NEWLINE}Pokémon shall be known as {VAR:0101:0}!{SCROLL}Much better than before, isn’t it?{NEWLINE}Great!

strings.zh: 好咧,从今以后{NEWLINE}这个精灵就叫{VAR:0101:0}！{SCROLL}看起来和之前一样啊？{NEWLINE}这是错觉吧。{SCROLL}自己觉得好就可以了！
strings.en: All right! From now on, this Pokémon{NEWLINE}shall be known as {VAR:0101:0}!{SCROLL}Looks the same as before? Your eyes{NEWLINE}are playing tricks on you.{SCROLL}As long as you like it, that’s what{NEWLINE}matters!

strings.zh: 我儿子的志向是成为口袋妖怪博士,{NEWLINE}看他这么努力的样子,{CLEAR}我真的很欣慰。
strings.en: My son dreams of becoming a Pokémon{NEWLINE}Professor. Seeing him work so hard{CLEAR}makes me so proud.

strings.zh: 哦？你是训练家吗？{SCROLL}虽然你的战斗技巧可能比我强,{NEWLINE}但是论精灵知识的丰富程度,{CLEAR}我可不会输给你。{SCROLL}不信的话我就出几个题考考你,{NEWLINE}怎么样,有信心回答我的问题吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh? You’re a Trainer?{SCROLL}You may battle better than me, but{NEWLINE}when it comes to Pokémon knowledge, I{CLEAR}won’t lose to you.{SCROLL}Don’t believe me? Then I’ll quiz you.{NEWLINE}Think you can answer my questions?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 好,下面请听第一题：{NEWLINE}口袋妖怪有多少种属性？{SCROLL}
strings.en: All right, here’s the first question:{NEWLINE}How many Pokémon types are there?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 接下来是第二题：{NEWLINE}某一属性相克时,{CLEAR}造成的伤害变为多少倍？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Next, question two: When a type has the{NEWLINE}advantage, how much damage does it{CLEAR}deal?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 1倍
strings.en: 1x

strings.en: Here’s question three: What are the{NEWLINE}three categories of Pokémon moves?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 看来你对训练家的基础掌握得不错,{NEWLINE}不过口袋妖怪的世界{CLEAR}远比我的问题复杂。{SCROLL}这个送给你,希望你坚持探索,{NEWLINE}最终成为一名优秀的训练家。
strings.en: Looks like you’ve got a good handle on{NEWLINE}Trainer basics. But the world of{CLEAR}Pokémon is far more complicated than my{CLEAR}questions.{SCROLL}Take this. I hope you keep exploring{NEWLINE}and become a great Trainer someday.

strings.zh: 我既没有什么身世背景,{NEWLINE}也没有成为训练家的天赋,{CLEAR}更不愿与某些人狼狈为间赚黑心钱。{CLEAR}所以我只能靠努力读书{CLEAR}去获得更多的知识,{CLEAR}以此来追求理想中的生活。
strings.en: I don’t have a famous family, and I{NEWLINE}don’t have a talent for being a Trainer.{SCROLL}And I won’t team up with certain people{NEWLINE}to make dirty money.{SCROLL}So all I can do is study hard and learn{NEWLINE}more...{SCROLL}and chase the life I dream of that way.

strings.zh: 刚才的回答有错误哦,{NEWLINE}看来你还需要再好好学习一下。
